families.title: OS-served OpenData catalogue
families.scope: Captured OpenData products and documentation references; includes partner-produced resources.

families.title: OS product and service catalogue
families.scope: Broader catalogue of downloads, APIs and services including products outside the OpenData API.

families.title: OS NGD API collections, schemas and queryables
families.scope: Versioned API collections, feature-property schemas, queryable fields and advertised temporal extents.

families.title: OS NGD Select+Build and nine theme documentation
families.scope: All indexed NGD documentation pages are captured with bounded structural projections. Reviewed code-list tables retain native Label rows and their source positions; labels are not silently treated as API enum constraints or merged concepts. Download feature types and code lists extend beyond the API collection surface; full field semantics and cross-list identity/version relationships remain unproved.

families.title: OS GEMINI metadata catalogue
families.scope: Metadata records declare products, themes, dates and profiles. Catalogue items are metadata, not NGD feature items.

families.title: OS API specifications and technical guides
families.scope: Separate OpenAPI fragments describe operations, constraints and security; documented operations are not admitted MCP tools.

families.title: OS download product specifications and release notes
families.scope: The complete published navigation index and two selected refresh/withdrawal guides are captured. Other indexed product guides, specifications and release histories remain references; the index includes historic/template pages.

families.title: OS Net and positioning services
families.scope: Positioning and reference-network services belong to the broader geospatial inventory, not the OpenData product denominator.

families.title: ONS dataset API catalogue
families.scope: Dataset identities, editions and versions; publication cadence, units, methodology and next release where supplied.

families.title: ONS version metadata and time options
families.scope: Current advertised edition/version metadata and native time-dimension options; historic version traversal is separate.

families.title: Nomis statistical dataset definitions
families.scope: Native SDMX key families and dimensions for population, labour market and historical Census data. Statistical FREQ is separate from release cadence.

families.title: Nomis time code lists and revisions
families.scope: Time-dimension metadata retains native periods and revision annotations without downloading observations.

families.title: ONS Open Geography and public organisation items
families.scope: Boundaries, names/codes, lookups, postcode and UPRN products, services, guides and alternative representations at explicit vintages.

families.title: ONS hosted geography service and layer schemas
families.scope: Each service/layer has its own fields, geometry type, CRS, domains and capabilities. Item metadata is not a complete layer-schema inventory.

families.title: ONS website dataset and publication discovery
families.scope: Website search includes datasets, articles, bulletins, methodology and related content beyond the dataset API.

families.title: ONS CDID time-series metadata
families.scope: Search returns CDID, dataset ID and canonical URI. A retained time-series URI does not pin an observation vintage.

families.title: ONS release catalogue and feeds
families.scope: Publication events include announced, published, revised, cancelled and postponed releases. RSS is a recent change signal; historical coverage requires an explicit calendar interval.

families.title: ONS Census population types and custom-dataset definitions
families.scope: Population, area type, dimensions and categorisations describe a query space; disclosure checks mean not every combination is an available dataset.

families.title: ONS code lists and hierarchies
families.scope: Preserve code-list/edition/code identities and links to dataset dimensions. A shared label does not establish semantic equivalence.

families.title: ONS statistical classifications and standards
families.scope: SIC, SOC, NS-SEC and correspondence tables have distinct versions and adoption schedules; preserve the version actually used by each dataset.

families.title: ONS quality, methodology and statistical concepts
families.scope: QMI and guides establish strengths, limitations, comparability and methods. Publication timing alone does not decide applicability.

families.title: Explore Local Statistics
families.scope: Earlier okf-ons captured an application metadata projection. Current application data and catalogue parity need fresh verification.

families.title: ONS controlled research and secure data discovery
families.scope: Public discovery and approval information can be represented. Secure microdata and research outputs are excluded from this public metadata capture.

enumerationRule: Close each lane against its own reported denominator or document why no complete denominator is available.
